training_and_placement_cell.head: Dr. Vijay Krishnaswamy
training_and_placement_cell.location: Main Block, Ground Floor, Room G-12

eligibility.note: Individual company criteria may be stricter; check each company's specific eligibility

steps: Register on placement portal with accurate academic details
Attend pre-placement training (aptitude, technical, soft skills)
Apply for companies during drives as announced by TPC
Shortlisting based on resume / academic score
1 student = 1 offer policy (after accepting an offer, student exits placement process)
placement_process.one_offer_policy: Once a student accepts a job offer, they may not participate in further placement drives for better packages. Exception: Dream Company drives for packages > 1.5× accepted offer, subject to TPC discretion.

aptitude_training.schedule: Year 3, Semester 6 – Every Saturday 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM

topics: Core CS subjects (OS, DBMS, CN, OOP)

higher_education_guidance.gate_coaching: GATE orientation sessions available in Semester 7 (enroll via student affairs)
higher_education_guidance.gre_gmat_coaching: Tie-up with IELTS/GRE prep centers (details at TPC)
higher_education_guidance.mba_entrance: CAT, MAT, XAT awareness workshops in October each year
higher_education_guidance.foreign_universities: International Relations Office assists with SOP, LOR, and visa guidance

summer_internship.how_to_secure: Via TPC drives, LinkedIn, Internshala, or self-arranged (requires NOC)

internship_policy.internshala_partnership: GITS is a registered Internshala campus partner
